fix: Each back event (dispatch_back_inner) collects three fresh Vecs (children, handlers, guards) plus a Vec passed into dispatch_pop. Keep the snapshot semantics (callbacks may mutate the registries during dispatch) but snapshot into inline storage: add `smallvec` to crates/incular-widgets/Cargo.toml if absent, then use `SmallVec<[Rc<RefCell<DispatcherState>>; 4]>` for children, `SmallVec<[BackHandler; 4]>` for handlers and `SmallVec<[(PopCanPop, PopInvoked); 4]>` for guards (collect with `.collect::<SmallVec<_>>()`), and change dispatch_pop's `guards` parameter to the same SmallVec type. Typical counts then never touch the heap.

The visited set is created and inserted into on every back dispatch and every child recursion, and HashSet::insert allocates its table. Cycles are possible (attach_child does not reject ancestors), so keep cycle detection but store identities inline: change `visited: &mut HashSet<usize>` to `visited: &mut SmallVec<[usize; 8]>`, use `let mut visited = SmallVec::new();` in dispatch_back and dispatch_back_with_fallback, and replace the insert with `if visited.contains(&identity) { return ...; } visited.push(identity);`. Dispatcher depth is tiny, so the linear scan is cheaper than hashing. Drop the HashSet import if unused.

The builder passed to animated_widget_for runs again on each animation value change, and this block allocates a new Rc plus two Option<Rc> clones every time, although none of it depends on the animation value. Hoist the block above the `crate::explicit_animations::animated_widget_for(animation, move |_| {` call (`let dismiss: Rc<dyn Fn()> = Rc::new(move || { if let Some(callback) = &on_dismiss { callback(); } else if let Some(callback) = &dismissal_handler { let _ = callback(); } });`), so the builder only captures `dismiss` and uses `dismiss.clone()` (already done at the two existing use sites).

ExplicitSemantics (role, label, tap hint, Activate action) is rebuilt inside the per-animation-value builder, cloning semantics_label and semantics_on_tap_hint Strings on every build. None of these inputs depends on the animation value. Build the explicit semantics once before `animated_widget_for` (role, `.label(label.clone())`, `.description(hint.clone())`, `.actions([SemanticActionKind::Activate])` as applicable), then move it into the closure and reuse it there (use `.clone()` on it only if ExplicitSemantics is Clone; check incular-semantics before relying on that). This removes the per-build String allocations.

Dropping a BackRegistration silently unregisters its callback, and nothing warns when a caller discards the token (`let _ = dispatcher.add_handler(..)`). Add `#[must_use = "dropping a BackRegistration unregisters its callback"]` to the struct.
